rulings.why: The test run accepted Rosa’s coin-handover move, transferring 10 coins from Ines to Rosa with no blockers. Rosa is the actor, so the transfer correctly depends on her choice rather than taking Ines’s coins on Ines’s move alone.

action.description: Accept a handover of coins from the named trader.

mechanic.rationale: A person may accept coins offered by a trader at the same location, if the trader has enough coins.

checks.label: the named trader has enough coins
the trader and accepting person are at the same location

limits: The accepting person chooses whether to accept; the rule does not compel acceptance.
tests: A trader with at least 10 coins hands 10 coins to an accepting person at the same location.
semantic_bindings: actor is the person accepting the coins
recipient is the trader handing over the coins
amount is the number of coins handed over
